item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 6 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 6 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 14 August 2026(Friday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Bataan(Bagac, Mariveles, Morong, Limay, Orion, Pilar, Balanga) and Zambales(San Antonio, Subic, Olongapo).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Zambales(Botolan, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Candelaria, Iba, Masinloc, Palauig, Santa Cruz, Castillejos, San Felipe, San Narciso), Bataan(Abucay, Dinalupihan, Hermosa, Orani, Samal), Pampanga(Floridablanca, Lubao, Sasmuan, Macabebe, Masantol, Guagua, Minalin, Apalit, Santa Rita, Santo Tomas, San Simon, Bacolor, San Fernando), Bulacan(Calumpit, Hagonoy, Paombong, Bulakan, Malolos, Obando, Meycauayan, Marilao, Bocaue, Balagtas, Guiguinto, Pulilan, Plaridel, San Jose del Monte, Santa Maria, Pandi, Bustos, Baliuag), Cavite(Ternate, Maragondon, Naic, Tanza, Rosario, Cavite City, Noveleta, Bacoor, Kawit, Imus, General Trias) and Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Nueva Ecija, Quezon, Laguna, Tarlac, Cavite(Dasmarinas, Carmona, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Silang, Amadeo, Trece Martires, Indang, Tagaytay, Mendez, Alfonso, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Magallanes) and Batangas(Balayan, Tuy, Calatagan, Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balete, Batangas City, Bauan, Calaca, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Laurel, Lemery, Lipa, Lobo, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Taal, Talisay, Taysan, Tingloy) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate rains affecting Rizal(Antipolo, Rodriguez, San Mateo, Angono, Baras, Binangonan, Cainta, Cardona, Morong, Taytay, Teresa), Bulacan(Angat, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael) and Pampanga(Arayat, Candaba, Magalang, Mexico, San Luis, Santa Ana, Angeles, Mabalacat, Porac) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
